episodes.title: Tame Impala, Lame Impala, Reggaenomics for a Real Republican & the Great Ball-Loofah Debate
episodes.guest: Nick from the Rational Republicans podcast
episodes.description: Troy and Ryan dig into Tame Impala's 2015 synth-pop landmark Currents with guest Nick from the Rational Republicans podcast, then debut a run of new Permanent Records tracks — including lush Lame Impala parodies and a lengthy tangent on hygiene and reality TV.

episodes.title: Deltron 3030, Costco Pizza & "Knob Fatigue"
episodes.description: A deep dive into the sci-fi rap concept album Deltron 3030 by Del the Funky Homosapien, Dan the Automator and Kid Koala — plus new songs from Kall of Booty, Robert Dinero and The Random Ass All Stars, and a Costco food-court obsession that spills into two original tracks.

episodes.title: Reacting Dad — Linkin Park Meteora vs. LinkedIn Park
episodes.description: TikTok personality @reactingdad_ joins to react to Linkin Park's 2003 nu-metal juggernaut Meteora, alongside the LinkedIn Park parody and new Permanent Records releases about jackets, raccoons, dairy and layoffs.

episodes.title: Elvis Costello — My Aim Is True; plus Smellevator, Elvis Cosmello, Papa John Windy
episodes.description: Michael Rae returns to talk through Elvis Costello's 1977 debut My Aim Is True, and the episode DJs in one of the biggest batches of original songs yet — Elvis Cosmello rock parodies, more Smellevator, and Papa John Windy's indie-folk debut.

episodes.title: The Offspring — Americana; plus Smellevator, Nasally Yours, NOFNS
episodes.description: Guest Chris brings The Offspring's 1998 skate-punk smash Americana, and the studio releases include Nasally Yours' emo debut and another Smellevator hotel-elevator saga.

episodes.title: The Stone Roses; plus The Mouse House & Goo Wave
episodes.description: Guest Joe picks The Stone Roses' 1989 self-titled debut for a long look at the band's history and influence, and the episode premieres the title track of the Smellevator project.

episodes.title: "Best Of" Permanent Records Episode
episodes.description: A clip show rounding up the strongest original tracks so far — Gasoline Dion, Robert Dinero, Kall of Booty, Reggaenomics and more — including the Simon & Garfunkel send-up 'Fart Garfunkel.'

episodes.title: Can: Ege Bamyasi vs. Can't: Egg Basmati
episodes.description: A review of the 1972 krautrock masterpiece Ege Bamyasi by Can, paired with new material from the similarly named Permanent Records band Can't — including the food-allergy jam 'Peanuts.'
